# Things that only look like differences

If 1 < 2 and 3 > 4 then the arithmetic is prose, not a tag.

Write `<b>` in backticks to show the tag itself, and $a < b$ in maths.

The array subscript arr[0][1] is not a reference link.

[see]: the section below is not a definition either.
